scope: All 262 consumed cases; classic production default. Printed and completed evidence stay separate. Unconstrained selection receives no reference labels; constrained passes are diagnostic only. No model is trained.

semantics.feasible: Full-source complete-hand feasibility with all relevant reference digits constrained; unannotated digits are optimized, never treated as gold
semantics.featureComparison: A comparison of the selected completion with the minimum-default-cost reference-compatible completion. Dominance and equal features concern this pair, not every possible completion under other weights.
semantics.alternatives: One whole reference alternative per counterfactual. Source-authored anchors are preserved; conflicting reference labels are diagnosed.
